##### Project general facts

Coco Lifestyle Resort Melasti Beach is the tenth development by Coco Development Group and the second project under the Coco Lifestyle Resort brand. The offering comprises branded, leasehold residences across three formats — Coco Cabana, Coco Solea, and Coco Horizonte — ranging from one to two bedrooms, each held on a renewable 30-year lease. The project is positioned as a fully serviced lifestyle resort rather than a stand-alone residential building.

Residents have access to a full suite of on-site lifestyle facilities, including a performance gym with structured classes and coaching, a wellness and recovery area with a sauna and ice bath, a dedicated co-working workspace, and Tierra Spa, offering traditional Balinese treatments and modern therapies. The development also includes rooftop and pool areas, along with a program of resident experiences such as oceanfront pilates sessions, community dining, and sunset sessions.

Interiors draw on a material palette of clean, modern lines combined with volcanic stone and lime plaster, limestone, and artisanal rattan and hand-woven detailing, with teak, linen, and boucle textures throughout. Coco Horizonte residences include a fully equipped kitchen, while all layouts include a dedicated workstation. The residences are delivered unfurnished.


##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Melasti in Uluwatu is one of the most scenic and up-and-coming coastal destinations on the southern peninsula of Bali, known for its dramatic limestone cliffs and crystal-clear waters. The area is centered around the famous Melasti Beach, where white sand shores meet turquoise ocean views, creating a striking natural setting and a serene atmosphere ideal for both relaxation and upscale living.

Melasti is rapidly gaining popularity as a premium lifestyle destination, with a growing collection of beach clubs, luxury villas, and boutique resorts. Its peaceful environment offers a more exclusive alternative to busier parts of Bali, while still providing access to vibrant dining, wellness, and leisure experiences. The combination of untouched природна beauty and curated developments makes it especially attractive for high-end residential projects.

Despite its tranquil setting, Melasti benefits from convenient access to key areas such as Ungasan, central Uluwatu, and Ngurah Rai International Airport. With ongoing infrastructure improvements and increasing demand for cliffside and beachfront properties, the area continues to evolve into one of Bali’s most desirable locations for investment and refined coastal living.
